answer: Make every agent stake a small deposit before it can trade, and hold it in a shared harbor wallet that only releases it after a month of honest work. A new account starts on a low ridge with tiny limits, so a fake army of fresh accounts cannot move real volume. Freeze the stake like a glacier during disputes: if peers flag an agent, its funds stay locked until the case is settled, so spawning a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand deposits and buys nothing.
